title: Group epoch: default to monotonic clock and bound negative grace delta
description: Security+correctness review findings on worker6-9mkj.1. (a) group_oscore_epoch.py:50-51,171 default time_ms_func is time.time(); a stepped/rewound wall clock makes now-rekey_time negative and the grace check accepts the old key indefinitely (rewind) or expires it early (forward step). Default for an elapsed-time security window should be time.monotonic_ns()//10**6, or at minimum clamp negative elapsed with a doc note. (b) group_oscore_epoch.py:171 now - rekey_time <= GRACE has no lower bound: clock set arbitrarily far back keeps previous key valid indefinitely (bounded blast radius: only immediately-previous epoch; rollback/future rejected regardless). Fix: require now_ms >= rekey_time or bound the negative delta; pick one behavior and document. Injectable clock for vectors remains legitimate trusted-caller flexibility.
